west_coast.tagline: Short throws as an extension of the run.
west_coast.philosophy: Uses quick, timing routes to control the ball and protect the quarterback. It creates yards after catch through spacing and rhythm. Precision and decision-making beat pure arm strength.
west_coast.ideal_players: Accurate QB, quick slot receivers, pass-catching back, athletic tackles

air_raid.tagline: Spread them out and throw it.
air_raid.philosophy: Four receivers every snap to stress the secondary horizontally and vertically. Simple concepts run at high tempo create mental errors for defenses. It's built on quarterback reps and space.
air_raid.ideal_players: Gunslinger QB, deep threat WRs, interior linemen who pass protect

spread_option.tagline: Read one man, make him wrong.
spread_option.philosophy: Quarterback run threat creates an extra gap for the defense to defend. RPOs attach passes to run looks, forcing conflict. Tempo amplifies the advantage.
spread_option.ideal_players: Dual-threat QB, speed at receiver, athletic guards, versatile tight end

power_run.philosophy: Gap scheme runs with pulling linemen and lead blockers to create downhill lanes. Controls clock and wears down fronts. Play action shots come off heavy run fakes.
power_run.ideal_players: Mauling OL, power back, blocking fullback, Y tight end

zone_run.tagline: Let the back find the daylight.
zone_run.philosophy: Linemen move laterally in unison, creating cutback lanes for a patient runner. Bootlegs and nakeds build off the flow. Emphasizes vision over power.
zone_run.ideal_players: One-cut RB, athletic zone blockers, mobile QB, smart receivers

pro_style.philosophy: Balanced attack from under center and shotgun with multiple personnel groups. Uses the full route tree and protection schemes. Demands a quarterback who can manage complexity.
pro_style.ideal_players: Pro-style QB, complete TE, balanced WR room, intelligent OL

run_and_shoot.philosophy: Receivers adjust routes based on coverage leverage after the snap. Creates constant spacing problems and big plays. Requires elite chemistry between QB and WRs.
run_and_shoot.ideal_players: Veteran QB, four smart fast WRs, pass-pro OL

pistol.tagline: Hide the run, keep the pass.
pistol.philosophy: Back lines up behind QB for downhill runs while keeping spread passing angles. Play action is deadly because run direction is hidden. Marries old school and new school.
pistol.ideal_players: Balanced QB, north-south runner, athletic interior OL

tampa_2.philosophy: Safeties split the deep halves while the Mike runs the pipe down the middle. Front four must generate pressure alone. It's about discipline, speed, and taking the ball away.
tampa_2.ideal_players: Fast MLB, 4-man rush, rangy safeties, tackling corners

press_man.philosophy: Corners play tight man coverage to disrupt timing, freeing safeties to help elsewhere or blitz. Aggressive by nature and vulnerable if you lose one-on-one. Built for alpha corners.
press_man.ideal_players: Physical press corners, versatile safeties, elite edge rushers

zone_blitz.philosophy: Sends pressure from unexpected spots while dropping linemen into short zones. Confuses protections and forces hot throws into traps. Requires smart, versatile front seven.
zone_blitz.ideal_players: Hybrid edge players, smart ILBs, zone-aware DL

3_4_base.philosophy: Three down linemen occupy blockers so four linebackers can flow and blitz from anywhere. Great for stopping power run and disguising pressure. Needs a dominant nose.
3_4_base.ideal_players: Space-eating NT, long 5-techs, athletic inside backers, edge setters

4_3_under.philosophy: Shifts line to the weak side to create one-on-ones for the Leo rusher. Sam lines up on the line, Will flows free. Popularized by Seattle defenses. Fast and physical.
4_3_under.ideal_players: Explosive Leo, rangy Will, stout 1-tech, big strong safety

hybrid_multiple.philosophy: Mixes 3-4, 4-3, nickel, and dime looks week to week. Goal is to never let the offense get comfortable. Demands high football IQ across the defense.
hybrid_multiple.ideal_players: Positionless defenders, hybrid safety/LB, versatile DL, smart communicators
